usage: The word 飯枱 (faan6 toi4) is a noun that refers to a dining table, a common piece of furniture in homes and restaurants.
In sentences, 飯枱 usually functions as the subject or object when talking about eating or family meals.
You can describe the size or color of the 飯枱 by adding adjectives before it, e.g., 大飯枱 (daai6 faan6 toi4) means big dining table.
It often appears in contexts related to eating, hosting guests, or arranging furniture in the home.
The word can be combined with verbs like 擺 (baai2, put/place) or 清潔 (cing1 git3, clean) to describe actions involving the dining table.
